name: Twin Spires
description: Two crumbling watchtowers mark the only high ground for miles — whoever holds them commands the field.

setup.label: Spires
setup.description: Place 2 terrain Spires 10" from each table edge along the centerline.

results.text: Gain 2 VP for controlling a Spire at the end of the game.

questRules.description: A Spire is controlled by whichever player has the most models within 3" of it at the end of the game.
